title: The 2026 World Cup didn't just cause global celebrations when Argentina lost — it might also have altered global web traffic and online behavior around the world
summary: Japanese traffic ran at roughly double normal levels; Brazilian traffic sat about a quarter below normal. A smaller group of eight countries across 18 matches did the exact opposite, with traffic falling during those same pauses.
